checks: The modal names the server-resolved path and signature for a cold sales sequence
The sent subject and body are shown with the worker's substitution applied
The modal is titled as the sent message and keeps the old editor sample behind a labelled disclosure
The preview came from the real route with CSRF (200)
A step using {{estimatedSavings}} is shown as blocked, not as a clean message
Previewing created no step or outbound message and left the sequence paused
The editor opens on the stored template and shows its live version
The final preview frame re-renders with the edited wording and sample recipient
Saving a draft leaves the live wording, version and activation unchanged
Discarding removes the draft and nothing else
qualification: Real-browser run of the Sequences step 'Message as sent' preview and the stored-template draft editor on a disposable database with only the campaigns and templates-settings routes registered. Not campaign editor, not published-candidate or production acceptance.
